title: Upgrades
help: Upgrade one component of a cluster: dry run first, then one node at a time, with the old version kept for a rollback.
order_replicas_first: standbys first, then the primary (after a switchover)
sshHelp: SSH: the cluster's stored secret is used. Or give a login here (this run only, never saved).
busy: An upgrade is running on this cluster.
stopRule: It stops at the first node that fails; the next nodes are not touched.
keptIn: The old packages, configs and a manifest are kept on each node in /var/lib/pg_mantra/upgrade/<run>/.
nothingToDo: Everything is at the newest allowed version: nothing to upgrade.
allowUnsaved: Upgrade even if the old package cannot be kept
start: Choose a cluster and a component, then start a dry run.
confirmRun: {{comp}} will be upgraded on {{n}} node(s), one at a time, as listed in the plan. Each is restarted once.
confirmRollback: The saved versions of {{comp}} will be put back, one node at a time, and restarted.
s_pause: pause Patroni (no failover during the restart)
s_switchover: switchover: the primary role moves to {{to}}
s_switchoverBack: switchover away from the primary first
s_wait: wait until healthy (stops here if not)
